title: Perdikis2018: CNBI EPFL Cybathlon BCI-race motor-imagery dataset
description: EEG recordings from two tetraplegic pilots of team Brain Tweakers (CNBI, EPFL) during longitudinal motor-imagery BCI training for the Cybathlon 2016 BCI race. The dataset contains 16-channel EEG sampled at 512 Hz from cue-based offline calibration runs with three classes (both hands, both feet, rest). It is a BIDS re-release of the published Zenodo data, prepared via MOABB, and supports research on BCI learning in people with spinal cord injury.
methods_description: 16-channel EEG (Ag/AgCl electrodes, g.USBamp, 512 Hz, 50 Hz line frequency) recorded over sensorimotor areas. Pilots performed cued kinesthetic motor imagery of both hands, both feet, or rest (about 4 s imagery after a 1 s cue) to control an avatar in the BrainRunners game, with visual feedback. Runs spanned several recording days per pilot and were pooled as a single session.
